description: Post a new message to a neighborhood bulletin board. Prerequisite: caller must be a resident (fso_roommates row on a lot in target neighborhood) and not have moved in 7 days (unless admin: moderation_level > 0 bypasses the move penalty). Also gated by post-frequency: community posts at most once per Bulletin_Post_Frequency (default 3 days). Effect: fso_bulletin_posts row INSERT with type='community' (or 'mayor' if caller is the current mayor). Returns the created bulletin_id. Refuse paths: SEND_FAIL_NON_RESIDENT, SEND_FAIL_JUST_MOVED, SEND_FAIL_TOO_FREQUENT, SEND_FAIL_INVALID_TITLE (>64 chars), SEND_FAIL_INVALID_MESSAGE (>1000 chars), SEND_FAIL_GAMEPLAY_BAN. Wire: BulletinRequest{Type=POST_MESSAGE, TargetNHood, Title, Message, LotID=0} on city Aries; resolves on the next BulletinResponse (SEND_SUCCESS returns the BulletinItem).
call_signatures: cf $CF post-bulletin --subject '...' --body '...'                                                              # defaults neighborhood_id=1; subject <= 64 chars, body <= 1000
cf $CF post-bulletin --subject '...' --body '...' --lot_id <lot_id>                                            # attach a lot reference
cf $CF post-bulletin --subject '...' --body '...' --neighborhood_id <nhood>                                    # post to different nhood
common_mistakes: SEND_FAIL_JUST_MOVED (non-admin within 7 days of move) or SEND_FAIL_TOO_FREQUENT (Bulletin_Post_Frequency=3 days) → ok:false with enum-named reason.
perception_hints: Neighborhood id (defaults to 1 on workshop): perception.lot.lot_id is a lot id, not a nhood id — most ops default nhood_id to 1
Your own persist_id (to avoid self-vote/self-nominate): perception.avatar.persist_id
Your lot membership (residency gate): perception.lot.owner_is_me or check is_roommate via query-lot
refuse_conditions: subject > 64 chars or body > 1000 chars → ok:false
SEND_FAIL_JUST_MOVED / SEND_FAIL_TOO_FREQUENT / other SEND_FAIL_* → ok:false with enum reason
